_comment: Avatar head through OmniRoute (Joshua 2026-09-08: OmniRoute models, not a local ComfyUI). Step 1 drafts the character prompt with a chat model, step 2 renders it with the one image model the /images/generations route accepts today, and saves the PNG under ops/avatar/out/ (gitignored). Business-only, illustrated original character, no real face, no likeness. Video: no video model is in the gateway catalog and the /videos route is UNVERIFIED, so the clip stage stays with ffmpeg Ken Burns per hermes-youtube-avatar-head. Run: npm run fable -- workflow avatar

args.system: You write image-generation prompts. Output one paragraph, no preamble, no quotes, no list.
args.message: Write a single image prompt for a front-facing bust portrait of an original illustrated character to be used as a channel avatar: friendly confident expression, looking at the camera, clean cel shading, head and shoulders, plain soft-gradient studio background, soft key light, sharp focus. It must be an original character, not a real person or celebrity, not photorealistic. End the prompt with: no text, no watermark, no logo.
One line for the packet: the avatar still was rendered by ${still.model}, ${still.bytes} bytes, saved to ${still.files}. Restate that as a plain sentence.
